scope.title: Implementation sections and handoffs
scope.boundary: Retain the parent-owned Implement/Bugfix/CI boundaries. Semantic outcomes are review procedures; CI declaration parsing has executable protection.

initial_state: Use the independent nine-name CI_ASSEMBLIES fixture and an otherwise valid current CI body. Change only the Assemblies declaration.

Use the Review fixture basis in the strategy plus this case’s concrete facts and counterexample. Resolve every actual instruction and authority claim to the exact current owner/body/triggered resources.
Materialize a fresh private review packet for each variant. F0/F1/F2, G0/G1/G2 and S0/S1 are synthetic byte-identity labels; an actual assessment records inspected identities.
Inspect proposed decisions, outputs and prohibited side effects without running an agent or writing production, workflow records, hosted CI or publication state.

cases.title: CI assembly declaration preserves unknown-first admission
cases.risk: A malformed declaration hides an unknown supported action behind a missing/duplicate error.

conditions: Begin with the valid nine-name table. Combine CIM9-unknown with a duplicate known name and missing required names; also inspect isolated missing and duplicate variants.

when: Validate the complete declaration and each malformed table.
then: The complete table passes; the mixed case returns exactly unknown CI assembly: CIM9-unknown; isolated missing and duplicate cases identify their exact assembly. This does not prove semantic assembly selection.

cases.title: Implementation proof hands exact work to independent review
cases.risk: Implementation marks its own milestone accepted or skips review after a green local test.

conditions: Use one approved milestone with named write scope and proof, plus a counterexample whose package lacks a required Design decision.

On fresh packets compare IP0 isolated work, IP1 approved planned work and IP2 planned work with valid armed authority. Add a known missing in-scope fixture/assertion and an unplanned automation request as counterexamples.

when: Trace proof first, scoped implementation and the proposed handoff to Code Review.
then: Valid work reports exact changed subjects and actual proof for independent review; the missing decision returns to its owner before dependent implementation. A green check does not close the milestone or replace final whole-change review/Verify.

Handoff is scope-complete: known in-scope defects or missing required proof are corrected before review, or reported as an owned blocker rather than completed work. Core results apply to all profiles, planned fields only to IP1/IP2 and armed fields only to IP2. Unplanned automation rejects; late planned/armed triggers load their complete method without expanding authority.

gaps: Perform this procedure against the exact selected package and record the independent assessment; text assertions do not establish this outcome.

cases.title: Bugfix write scope follows the selected operation
cases.risk: Diagnosis or proof-authoring silently expands into production correction.

conditions: Use the same synthetic defect: a batch importer commits row 1 before rejecting invalid row 2. A known contract requires an unchanged destination. On fresh requests select diagnose-only, proof-authoring limited to tests, or production correction backed by a failing proof. No external mutation is authorized.

Within the fix request compare feasible but missing automated proof, unresolved test feasibility, conflicting proof, and infeasible automation with a complete deterministic alternative. The alternative supplies the exact inputs, original preserved destination, observed incorrect partial write, assumptions and limits.

when: Inspect proposed files/actions before mutation for each request. Compare diagnosis that edits production, proof-authoring that patches the importer and a production fix offered while the cause or intended behavior is unknown.
then: Diagnosis changes no tracked or external state. Proof-authoring changes only its authorized tests/fixtures. Production correction needs the known cause/contract and failing automated proof or the documented complete deterministic alternative; unknown behavior returns to Design. Changed implementation hands off to independent Code Review without claiming autonomous continuation.

Feasible missing proof selects proof authoring before production mutation; unresolved feasibility selects its resolution; conflicting proof blocks. Only established infeasibility plus the complete independent alternative can replace automated reproduction. The result distinguishes diagnosis-complete, diagnosis-incomplete, fix-applied, routed-to-owner and blocked without reporting intermediate actions as terminal completion.

gaps: Perform this procedure against the exact selected package and record the independent assessment; text assertions do not establish this outcome.

parameters.allowed: read-only reproduction/diagnosis; no tracked or external writes

parameters.required: known cause/contract plus failing proof or justified deterministic alternative

cases.title: CI invocation authority is resolved before a write
cases.risk: Read-only review or incomplete privileged authority becomes permission to mutate a workflow.

conditions: Use fictional workflow target ci-one.yml at identity F0 with a prepared timeout-only candidate F1. On fresh packets select review, ordinary revision with explicit file-write authority, or privileged revision whose Design omits its credential/runner choices. No external settings or hosted execution are authorized.

when: Inspect the proposed allowed writes and prerequisite decision before target mutation. Compare a review that writes F1 and a privileged revision that fills omitted security choices from a generic skeleton.
then: Review produces findings with F0 unchanged. An authorized ordinary revision may prepare its scoped candidate subject to the separate identity guard. The incomplete privileged revision stops before writing and returns the missing choices to its Design/review owners. Local results do not establish hosted CI or grant external execution.

gaps: Perform this procedure against the exact selected package and record the independent assessment; text assertions do not establish this outcome.

cases.title: Concurrent CI replacement preserves the newer target
cases.risk: A prepared revision overwrites a file changed after inspection.

conditions: Ordinary revision of ci-one.yml is authorized against F0 and candidate F1 is prepared. Before commit another actor replaces the target with F2. Compare an unchanged-F0 control; the target contract supplies identity-guarded replacement.

when: Inspect the expected identity, commit decision and resulting target for the F0 and F2 packets. Include a candidate that uses a plain overwrite followed only by readback.
then: The unchanged control can replace F0 with F1 and verify committed bytes. The drifted target remains exactly F2, the guard reports conflict and retry requires rereading/reassessment. Plain overwrite plus readback does not satisfy concurrency protection; an unavailable guard stops mutation.

gaps: Perform this independent decision/artifact walkthrough against exact subjects. Existing structural checks do not establish write authority, concurrency safety or recovery behavior; no workflow write is executed by the catalog.

cases.title: Interrupted CI changes report partial results before retry
cases.risk: A two-target partial write is reported as complete or retried against obsolete identities.

conditions: Two separately identified workflow targets ci-one.yml at F0 and ci-two.yml at G0 have authorized ordered-dependent revisions F1/G1. The declared intermediate state F1/G0 is valid. The first write commits F1; interruption occurs before the second. On retry another actor has changed ci-two.yml to G2.
In a separate starting packet the same two targets require an atomic group and the environment provides only single-file guards; no safe intermediate state exists.

when: Inspect the partial report and the retry packet. Compare a report claiming both targets completed and a retry using the original G0 without rereading current targets.
then: Report ci-one.yml completed at F1 and ci-two.yml pending; make no atomic-group or complete-success claim. Reassess both current identities and ordering before retry; preserve G2 while resolving its changed basis. No hosted CI pass or external permission is inferred.
The atomic-group-required packet blocks before either target is written. Ordinary independent targets and safe ordered-dependent changes do not imply multi-file transaction support.

gaps: Perform this independent decision/artifact walkthrough against exact subjects. Existing structural checks do not establish write authority, concurrency safety or recovery behavior; no workflow write is executed by the catalog.

cases.title: Bugfix evidence retains the original failing proof identity
cases.risk: A weakened replacement test is reported as the original regression passing.

conditions: The authorized correction has original failing proof T0 asserting the entire destination remains [(9, retained)] after rejecting row 2. The production fix is prepared. A proposed T1 drops the destination comparison and asserts only nonzero status. T0 and T1 are distinct proof identities.

when: Compare a handoff containing an identity-equal T0 rerun with a packet running only T1 but claiming the original regression now passes. Inspect exact proof subjects, actual results and surrounding-check allocation.
then: Only an observed rerun of the same T0 can support the original-proof-passed claim. T1 is a new basis and its weaker assertion leaves the original preservation outcome unresolved. Report the difference and route correction; do not overwrite T0 evidence or close independent Code Review/Verify from a modified test result.

gaps: Perform this procedure against the exact selected package and record the independent assessment; text assertions do not establish this outcome.

cases.title: CI classification selects one complete assembly with independent additions

gaps: Perform this independent procedure against the actual selected package and concrete decision/output packets; structural checks do not establish semantic selection, authority or hosted observations.

cases.risk: Combined coverage, structural or privilege conditions select an ordinary path that omits a required resource or authority.

conditions: Use fresh private request packets with exact create/revise/review operation, repository-file target, provider, concern, structural intent and privilege. Every authoring control supplies exact file authority and a declared safe write primitive; approved privilege includes all required Design/review choices.

Compare ordinary GitHub create, narrow revision, coverage revision, structural revision with and without coverage, privileged create/revise with independent structural/coverage additions, project-native authoring, and narrow/coverage review including external-state targets. Each packet names the actual resources available; no hosted or external settings mutation is authorized.
Use separate late coverage, structural and privilege additions, an unknown axis value, an external-state authoring request, and a project-native request missing its exact command/write contract.

when: Trace the current entrypoint and triggered methods for each packet. Inspect the selected assembly, reached resources, supplied external evidence and proposed permitted writes against the independently declared selection table.
then: Each valid packet selects exactly one full assembly identity from CIM0–CIM8. Review remains read-only regardless of provider/privilege; project-native authoring selects CIM6 and requires its native contract, without loading GitHub serialization.

Ordinary create selects CIM2 with risk map and skeleton; narrow/coverage/structural revision selects CIM3/CIM4/CIM5. Coverage adds its risk map independently to structural revision. Approved GitHub privilege selects CIM7/CIM8; revise independently adds coverage and structure resources when triggered.

Late additions reclassify and load the complete newly required resources before dependent action. Late privilege without exact Design/review stops; unknown values reject before consistency work, and external-state authoring or incomplete native authority cannot become a valid assembly.
Matching assembly words in a result or passing declaration parsing alone cannot establish unique semantic selection or complete resource reachability.

cases.title: Bounded PR CI repair preserves exact admission and hosted evidence

gaps: Perform this independent procedure against the actual selected package and concrete decision/output packets; structural checks do not establish semantic selection, authority or hosted observations.

cases.risk: A narrow CI repair exception admits changed product behavior or reports a replacement run for a different head as success.

conditions: The compliant packet has already-open PR P, current exact head H0, observed failing hosted run R0 for H0, current applicable Code Review and Verify, no open material finding, already-authoritative check commands and explicit authority for the required file commit and push. The candidate restores only the already-approved workflow command spelling.

Fresh counterexamples omit one admission prerequisite, change a dependency or product behavior, or present a replacement passing run R1 for H0 after the actual pushed head became H1. Another packet has only local check success and no observed replacement run.

when: Inspect admission, allowed correction, selected focused and exact PR checks, proposed commit/push, cumulative changed content, current attribution and the replacement-run/head readback. No real PR, push or hosted operation is performed by this review.
then: Only the complete authorized restoration packet can use bounded-pr-ci-repair. A missing prerequisite blocks; new product or decision-bearing behavior returns to the earliest applicable owner rather than using the exception.

The admitted correction runs the required authoritative checks, reports their actual outcomes and observes the replacement hosted run for the actual current pushed head. R1 for H0 cannot prove H1; local-only success reports hosted CI as unobserved.

Existing assessment/evidence may remain usable only while its decision basis remains unchanged under Assessment. The exception cannot create external permission, alter another owner’s decision, fabricate refreshed Verify or claim completion from unobserved hosted results.
